description: This file defines a Gemini embedding client and related functions for building requests, handling models, and integrating with external APIs for embedding tasks. It includes type definitions, utility functions, and provider creation logic.

classes.name: GeminiEmbeddingClient
classes.description: Type representing configuration and credentials for Gemini embedding API access.

methods.name: buildGeminiTextEmbeddingRequest
methods.description: Constructs a Gemini text embedding request object from parameters.

methods.name: buildGeminiEmbeddingRequest
methods.description: Builds a Gemini embedding request with input data, task type, and optional model path and output dimensions.

methods.name: isGeminiEmbedding2Model
methods.description: Checks if a model name is a Gemini-embedding-2 variant.

methods.name: resolveGeminiOutputDimensionality
methods.description: Validates and returns the output dimensionality for Gemini-embedding-2 models.

methods.name: normalizeGeminiModel
methods.description: Normalizes model string by trimming and removing prefixes.

methods.name: fetchGeminiEmbeddingPayload
methods.description: Performs API call to fetch embedding payload from Gemini service.

methods.name: normalizeGeminiBaseUrl
methods.description: Normalizes base URL for Gemini API, removing trailing slashes and '/openai' path.

methods.name: buildGeminiModelPath
methods.description: Constructs the model path string for API requests.

methods.name: createGeminiEmbeddingProvider
methods.description: Creates an embedding provider with embedding functions and client configuration.

methods.name: resolveGeminiEmbeddingClient
methods.description: Resolves and constructs the Gemini embedding client configuration based on options.
